comment: Fork (Zebrunner): the CI settings of the fork, read by
android.minApi drops the Android legs of .github/android-matrix.json below
that API level from the matrix and from the coverage check of the report:
Zebrunner farms run Android 12 (API 31) and later. The upstream matrix file
stays as it is, so new upstream legs come in with the merges.
ios.include is the matrix of .github/workflows/zebrunner-ios.yml, which ci.yml
runs, and the iOS legs the report expects. download: the simulator runtime
to install when the image has none of that version (iOS 15 comes from
xcodes). xcode: the Xcode of the runner image, its default without it
(the xcode-27 preview image). optional: why the leg does not fail the
report for now and what makes it required again; the report shows it as
a warning and the job may fail. Remove it once the leg passes.

include.optional: TODO make it required again (#1083). The iOS 27.1 runtime of the xcode-27 image has only the iPhone Duo, on which XCTest fails to start WebDriverAgent.
